findings.title: Flexing .small-action breaks its right-aligned button
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container, but its `button` still relies on `float: right` (line 309). Floats are ignored for flex items, so the button will be laid out directly after `.small-action-desc` instead of being pinned to the right edge. Add `margin-left: auto` to the button or use an appropriate flex alignment/justify setting.

findings.title: align-items mixin omits -moz-box-align
findings.body: `flexbox()` and `inline-flex()` emit `-moz-box`/`-moz-inline-box`, but `align-items()` only emits `-webkit-box-align`, `-webkit-align-items`, `-ms-flex-align`, and standard `align-items`. In older Firefox using the Mozilla box syntax, alignment will not be applied to `.d-header .contents`, `.small-action`, or `.badge-wrapper.bullet`, causing vertical misalignment. Add `-moz-box-align: $alignment;` (with any needed value mapping).
